historical_references.reference: Kunj Raja was a king of the Kunj dynasty in medieval Bengal, India. He ruled from 1476 to 1490 CE. Kunj Raja is known for his patronage of art and culture, particularly in the areas of music and literature. He was a disciple of the famous poet Chandidas and is said to have written several poems himself.
